{{Quote|At first, we suspected a feint, Admiral Griff...But the blockade's been hit at three different points. It's a major attack!|Admiral Griff's aide|<ref name="RfS" />}}
The '''Battle of Kli'aar''' was one of the three diversion attacks undertook by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] navy in order to aid the main fleet during the [[Evacuation of Yavin|evacuation]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Six months after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], three [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] fleet attacked the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces at three locations of the [[Yavin blockade|Blockade of Yavin]]: [[Kli'aar]], [[Pinoora]] and the [[Vallusk Cluster/Legends|Vallusk Cluster]].<ref name="TEA" /> However, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Amise Griff]], who was in charge of the blockade, was not fooled by the attacks, and refused to send additional ships to aid his forces under fire.<ref name="RfS" /> Griff then cut the Alliance evacuation route in the [[Tertiary Feswe system/Legends|Tertiary Feswe system]] but the Rebels eventually managed to escape at [[Feswe Prime]].<ref name="TEA" />
